newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Sept 2.
newsitem.headline: Singapore bunker final report and prices - Sept 2.

text.p: DELIVERED U.S.$/TONNE) 380 CST 180 CST MDO GAS OIL

COMMENTS - Singapore bunkers was quoted little changed from Friday amid thin enquiries, brokers said on Monday. They said this is despite firmer cargo prices. Bunker 180-cst at $113-$115 and 380-cst at $108-$110 per tonne. Shipowners remained at the sidelines, said a trader. MDO was steady at $190-$198 and gas oil at $205-$2065, unchanged from Friday. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-8703086)
